act.AMEND_REGISTRATION.label: Update claim details
act.AMEND_REGISTRATION.meaning: Update selected registration facts. Omitted facts and the case reference stay unchanged.
act.CLEAR_PAYMENT.label: Correct an erroneous payment record
act.CLEAR_PAYMENT.meaning: Remove an erroneously recorded payment date. This is not a refund or reversal of an actual transfer. Earlier history remains.
act.CLOSE.label: Close the case
act.CLOSE.meaning: Close the case. Closing does not mean that payment was made.
act.CORRECT.label: Correct case facts
act.CORRECT.meaning: Correct selected existing facts together. A paid decision change requires explicit payment reaffirmation, replacement or clearing. Clearing a payment date does not refund money.
act.DECIDE.label: Record payment decision
act.DECIDE.meaning: Record or replace the decided amount and currency. This does not send money.
act.DISABLE.label: Disable account
act.DISABLE.meaning: Disable this account. Its recorded changes remain.
act.ENABLE.label: Enable account
act.ENABLE.meaning: Enable this account with its existing roles.
act.ERASE.label: Erase case
act.ERASE.meaning: Remove this case and its details from ClaimCore. Copies held elsewhere remain.
act.ERASE_PROFILE.label: Erase profile
act.ERASE_PROFILE.meaning: Permanently remove the saved display name and contact details for this account. Its identity, access permissions and recorded work remain.
act.GRANT.label: Grant role
act.GRANT.meaning: Assign the selected role to this account.
act.OPEN.label: Open a case
act.OPEN.meaning: Register the incident, claimant, insurer and amount claimed.
act.PROVISION_OWNER.label: Provision owner
act.RECORD_PAYMENT.label: Record actual payment
act.RECORD_PAYMENT.meaning: Record the date the full decided amount was actually paid. This does not execute or verify a transfer.
act.REGISTER.label: Register account
act.REGISTER.meaning: Add a registered account with a name and optional contact details. Roles can be assigned separately.
act.REINSTATE.label: Reinstate case record
act.REINSTATE.meaning: Restore ordinary case work on a voided record.
act.REMINDER_CANCEL.label: Cancel reminder
act.REMINDER_CANCEL.meaning: Cancel this pending action without deleting its history. Cancellation is distinct from completion.
act.REMINDER_COMPLETE.label: Complete reminder
act.REMINDER_COMPLETE.meaning: Record that you marked the pending action complete. Completing the last reminder is allowed and may leave the case needing a next action.
act.REMINDER_COMPLETE_AND_PLAN_NEXT.mean: Complete this reminder and plan the next action together.
act.REMINDER_CREATE.label: Add reminder
act.REMINDER_CREATE.meaning: Plan the next action for this case.
act.REMINDER_REOPEN.label: Reopen reminder
act.REMINDER_REOPEN.meaning: Reopen this reminder with a new due date.
act.REMINDER_UPDATE.label: Update reminder
act.REMINDER_UPDATE.meaning: Change the action or date of this pending reminder. Earlier versions remain in history.
act.REOPEN.label: Reopen the case
act.REOPEN.meaning: Reopen the case, preserving its details and history.
act.REVOKE.label: Revoke role
act.SET_PROFILE.label: Update profile
act.SET_PROFILE.meaning: Record a display name and optional contact details for an account. This does not change its identity or access permissions.
act.UPDATE_WORK.label: Update case work
act.UPDATE_WORK.meaning: Change who is responsible or update the handling summary.
act.VOID.label: Void case record
act.VOID.meaning: Block business acts while retaining the case and its history.
act.WITHDRAW_DECISION.label: Withdraw payment decision
act.WITHDRAW_DECISION.meaning: Clear the unpaid decision while preserving its history.

field.incidentDate.rule: Use ASCII digits in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-10-06.
field.incidentNotificationDate.rule: Use ASCII digits in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-10-06.
field.incidentNotificationDate.hint: When you first heard about this incident.
field.incidentCountry.rule: Use two uppercase letters. {unknownCode} means unknown or international.
field.incidentDescription.rule: Optional plain text, up to {maximumScalars} Unicode scalar values. LF paragraph breaks are permitted. Whitespace and Unicode spelling are preserved; unsafe controls and directional formatting are refused.
field.incidentDescription.hint: What happened. Add the details that matter for this claim.
field.claimantName.hint: The person or company making the claim.
field.insurerName.hint: The insurer responsible for the claim.
field.claimedAmount.rule: Use up to {maximumIntegerDigits} digits before the decimal point and up to {maximumFractionDigits} after it. Use ASCII digits and a dot; no spaces, signs, commas or redundant leading zeros.
field.claimedAmount.hint: How much the claimant is asking for.
field.claimedCurrency.hint: The currency of the claimed amount.
field.caseReference.rule: Use 1 to {maximumCharacters} printable ASCII characters without spaces. Letter case identifies the same case; the original spelling is retained.
field.caseReference.hint: Your own reference for this case, for example CLM-2026-0001. It cannot be changed later.
field.paymentDecisionDate.rule: Use ASCII digits in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-10-06.
field.paymentDecisionDate.hint: When you decided the amount to pay.
field.payableAmount.rule: Use up to {maximumIntegerDigits} digits before the decimal point and up to {maximumFractionDigits} after it. Use ASCII digits and a dot; no spaces, signs, commas or redundant leading zeros.
field.payableAmount.hint: How much you decided should be paid.
field.payableCurrency.hint: The currency of the amount to be paid.
field.paymentDate.rule: Use ASCII digits in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-10-06.
field.paymentDate.hint: When the full amount was paid.
field.status.rule: Whether the case is open or closed. Closing a case does not mean that payment was made.
field.status.hint: Whether work on this case is still open.
field.responsibleActor.rule: Use the exact registered account UUID.
field.handlingSummary.rule: Optional plain text, up to {maximumScalars} Unicode scalar values. LF paragraph breaks are permitted. Whitespace and Unicode spelling are preserved; unsafe controls and directional formatting are refused.
field.handlingSummary.hint: The current situation and what needs doing.
field.operationId.rule: An ID for this operation. Reuse it only when retrying the same request.
field.operationId.hint: Keep this change identifier if you need to check what happened.
field.expectedRevision.rule: The case revision on which this request is based.
field.expectedRevision.hint: Check the latest case before changing it.
field.principal.kind.rule: Whether the target principal is a person or a service.
field.principal.kind.hint: Choose a person or a service account.
field.principal.issuer.rule: The exact HTTPS issuer of the target principal.
field.principal.issuer.hint: The sign-in provider for this account.
field.principal.subject.rule: The immutable subject or client ID of the target principal.
field.principal.subject.hint: The account identifier from the sign-in provider.
field.profile.displayName.hint: The name people will see in ClaimCore.
field.profile.contact.hint: Optional details for contacting this person.
field.grants.rule: Provide 1 to {maximumGrants} distinct role-and-scope pairs. Case references are explicit references, including UUID-looking references.
field.grants.hint: Add the roles this account needs and where they apply.
field.role.rule: The capability role to grant or revoke.
field.role.hint: What access this account should have.
field.limit.rule: The maximum number of rows to return on this page.
field.limit.hint: How many results to show at once.
field.cursor.rule: Continue the same query from the opaque cursor returned by the service.
field.text.hint: Find a case by its reference, claimant or insurer.
field.reminderId.rule: The immutable identity of one reminder in this case.
field.reminderAction.rule: Use one line of plain text, up to {maximumScalars} Unicode scalar values.
field.reminderDueDate.rule: Use a Gregorian date, YYYY-MM-DD. Past and future dates are allowed.
field.expectedWorkRevision.rule: The work revision you reviewed. Financial fact revisions are independent.
field.expectedWorkRevision.hint: Check the latest work details before changing them.
field.expectedReminderRevision.rule: The revision of this exact reminder that you reviewed. Other reminders have independent revisions.
field.expectedReminderRevision.hint: Check the latest reminder before changing it.
input.scope.rule: Whether the role applies to the installation or one case.
input.actorId.rule: The registered actor selected for grant review or authority history.
input.caseId.rule: Stable UUID of the accepted OPEN operation.
input.detail.rule: Include accepted snapshots when full history is visible to the actor.
input.detail.hint: Choose how much history to show.
input.lifecycle.rule: Restrict results to the selected lifecycles. Omit this filter to include every lifecycle.
input.lifecycle.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.status.rule: Restrict results to the selected open or closed statuses. Erased cases have no status.
input.status.hint: Whether work on this case is still open.
input.progress.rule: Restrict results to undecided, decided or paid cases. Erased cases have no payment progress.
input.progress.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.caseView.rule: Choose a standard case view. Other filters further restrict its results.
input.caseView.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.responsibleActorFilter.rule: Restrict cases to the selected responsible account within your readable scope. Other filters further restrict its results.
input.responsibleActorFilter.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.reminderView.rule: Choose a standard reminder view. Explicit state, assignment, date, text and parent filters further restrict its results.
input.reminderView.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.timelineFilter.rule: Show case facts or work and reminders. Leave unset to show both.
input.order.rule: Order by reference, latest case-fact change, notification date or earliest pending reminder date. Dates sort oldest first; reference breaks ties.
input.order.hint: Choose how to order the results.
input.assignment.rule: Filter factual responsibility after current visibility. A case-scoped read grant alone is not an assignment.
input.assignment.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.due.rule: Classify each case by its earliest pending reminder: overdue, today, upcoming, no pending reminder or inactive. Individual reminder queue dates use a separate filter.
input.due.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.reminderState.rule: Select current pending, completed or cancelled records. Omission selects pending reminders.
input.reminderState.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.reminderDue.rule: Filter individual reminder dates against the installation business date; this differs from the case minimum next due.
input.reminderDue.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.includeInactive.rule: Explicitly include work on closed or voided cases. Pending reminders retain their dates and state.
input.includeInactive.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.mine.rule: Cases currently assigned to you within your current read access. Assignment never grants access.
input.mine.hint: Choose the results you want to see.
input.responsibleActorAction.rule: Choose set or clear; omit to keep the current responsible account.
input.responsibleActorAction.hint: Set or clear the person responsible for this case.
group.registration.rule: Keep registration facts or update selected facts. Omitted facts stay unchanged; amount and currency are asserted together.
group.decision.rule: Keep the decision, update selected facts, or clear it. Amount and currency must be asserted together.
group.payment.rule: Keep, replace, reaffirm or clear the recorded payment date. Reaffirmation retains the date; clearing it does not refund money.

act.OPEN.consequence: Register the incident, claimant, insurer and amount claimed.
act.AMEND_REGISTRATION.consequence: Update selected registration facts. Omitted facts and the case reference stay unchanged.
act.CORRECT.consequence: Correct selected existing facts together. A paid decision change requires explicit payment reaffirmation, replacement or clearing. Clearing a payment date does not refund money.
act.DECIDE.consequence: Record or replace the decided amount and currency. This does not send money.
act.WITHDRAW_DECISION.consequence: Clear the unpaid decision while preserving its history.
act.RECORD_PAYMENT.consequence: Record the date the full decided amount was actually paid. This does not execute or verify a transfer.
act.CLEAR_PAYMENT.consequence: Remove an erroneously recorded payment date. This is not a refund or reversal of an actual transfer. Earlier history remains.
act.CLOSE.consequence: Close the case. Closing does not mean that payment was made.
act.REOPEN.consequence: Reopen the case, preserving its details and history.
act.VOID.consequence: The case stays recorded and leaves everyday work until it is reinstated.
act.REINSTATE.consequence: The case becomes active again. Its open or closed status stays the same.
act.ERASE.consequence: This permanently removes the case details, work and reminders from ClaimCore. The reference and record of changes remain.
act.REGISTER.consequence: Add a registered account with a name and optional contact details. Roles can be assigned separately.
act.ADMIT.consequence: This adds the account, saves its profile and records all selected roles together.
act.SET_PROFILE.consequence: Record a display name and optional contact details for an account. This does not change its identity or access permissions.
act.ERASE_PROFILE.consequence: This permanently removes the saved name and contact details. Previous changes show an anonymous account name.
act.GRANT.consequence: This records the selected role assignment for this account.
act.REVOKE.consequence: This removes the selected role assignment.
act.ENABLE.consequence: Enable this account with its existing roles.
act.DISABLE.consequence: This account loses access to ClaimCore. Its recorded changes stay recorded.
act.UPDATE_WORK.consequence: Change who is responsible or update the handling summary.
act.REMINDER_CREATE.consequence: Plan the next action for this case.
act.REMINDER_UPDATE.consequence: Change the action or date of this pending reminder. Earlier versions remain in history.
act.REMINDER_COMPLETE.consequence: Record that you marked the pending action complete. Completing the last reminder is allowed and may leave the case needing a next action.
act.REMINDER_CANCEL.consequence: Cancel this pending action without deleting its history. Cancellation is distinct from completion.
act.REMINDER_REOPEN.consequence: Reopen this reminder with a new due date.
act.REMINDER_COMPLETE_AND_PLAN_NEXT.done: Reminder completed and next action planned.
act.REMINDER_COMPLETE_AND_PLAN_NEXT.cons: Complete this reminder and plan the next action together.
endpoint.operation.resolve.consequence: This permanently marks the change as not recorded. Its change identifier cannot be used again.
